personalInfo.name: Kunal Lohaniya
personalInfo.title: Full Stack Developer
personalInfo.subtitle: MERN Stack Specialist
personalInfo.bio: Passionate full-stack developer with expertise in modern web technologies. I love creating innovative solutions and turning ideas into reality through code. Specializing in MERN stack development with a focus on scalable, performant applications.

projects.title: E-Commerce Platform
projects.description: A full-stack e-commerce solution with React, Node.js, and MongoDB. Features include user authentication, payment integration, and admin dashboard.
projects.longDescription: Built a comprehensive e-commerce platform from scratch using modern web technologies. Implemented secure user authentication, real-time inventory management, and integrated Stripe payment processing. The admin dashboard provides analytics and order management capabilities.
highlights: Implemented secure payment processing with Stripe
Built responsive admin dashboard with real-time analytics

projects.title: Task Management App
projects.description: A collaborative task management application with real-time updates, drag-and-drop functionality, and team collaboration features.
projects.longDescription: Developed a modern task management application with real-time collaboration features. Implemented WebSocket connections for live updates, drag-and-drop functionality for task organization, and comprehensive team management capabilities.

projects.title: Weather Dashboard
projects.description: A responsive weather dashboard with location-based forecasts, interactive maps, and detailed weather analytics.
projects.longDescription: Created a comprehensive weather application with location-based forecasts, interactive maps, and detailed weather analytics. Integrated multiple weather APIs for accurate data and implemented geolocation services for automatic location detection.
highlights: Interactive weather maps with multiple layers
Progressive Web App with offline capabilities

projects.title: Blog CMS
projects.description: A content management system for blogs with markdown support, SEO optimization, and comment system.
projects.longDescription: Built a modern blog CMS with markdown support, SEO optimization, and a comprehensive comment system. Implemented user authentication, content scheduling, and analytics dashboard for content creators.
highlights: SEO-optimized with Next.js and structured data
Advanced comment system with moderation tools

projects.title: Portfolio Website
projects.description: A modern, responsive portfolio website with smooth animations, dark mode, and contact form integration.
projects.longDescription: Designed and developed a modern portfolio website showcasing my skills and projects. Implemented smooth animations, dark mode toggle, and integrated contact form with backend processing.
highlights: Integrated contact form with email notifications

projects.title: API Gateway
projects.description: A microservices API gateway with authentication, rate limiting, and request routing capabilities.
projects.longDescription: Developed a robust API gateway for microservices architecture with JWT authentication, rate limiting, and intelligent request routing. Implemented monitoring and logging for better observability.
